example:
import { FormField, TranslatableTextarea } from "@godxjp/ui/data-entry";

<FormField label="説明">
  <TranslatableTextarea locales={["ja", "en", "vi"]} value={description} onValueChange={setDescription} autoGrow minRows={3} />
</FormField>
name: TranslatableTextarea

props.description: Controlled per-locale values, keyed by BCP-47 tag.
props.name: value

props.description: The whole map after an edit; only the active locale's key changes.
props.name: onValueChange

props.description: The BCP-47 tags the field edits, in tab order. Default: AppProvider `contentLocales` when set, else the app's registered locales.
props.name: locales

props.description: The locale tab selected first. Default: the first of AppProvider `contentLocales` when set and in `locales`, else the AppProvider's active locale.
props.name: defaultLocale

props.description: The locale whose text an empty locale shows as its placeholder. Default: the AppProvider's `fallbackLocale`.
props.name: fallbackLocale

props.description: Per-locale messages: tab marks for each, `aria-invalid` + FormField's error line for the active one.
props.name: errors

props.description: The field's control tier, as on Textarea.
props.name: size

props.description: Shown while the active locale is empty and there is no fallback text.
props.name: placeholder

props.description: Disables the control; the locale tabs stay operable.
props.name: disabled

related: TranslatableInput — the single-line form and the full contract.
tagline: TranslatableInput over a Textarea (gh#1336): one multi-line field holding a value per locale, switched by locale tabs. Same locale, fallback-placeholder, error-mark and FormField contract; every Textarea prop (rows, autoGrow, count…) applies to the one control.
usage: DO use it for per-locale multi-line content (a description, a recipe); for a single line use TranslatableInput.
DO wrap it in FormField, exactly as TranslatableInput.
useCases: Menu item description in ja, en and vi
Recipe or notice body stored per locale
